en.content: Choose the incorrect statement from the following:

options.content: The linear speed of a planet revolving around the sun remains constant.
When a body falls towards earth, the displacement of earth towards the body is negligible.
The speed of satellite in a given circular orbit remains constant.
For a planet revolving around the sun in an elliptical orbit, the total energy of the planet remains constant.

en.explanation: The linear speed of a planet revolving around the sun does not remain constant, as planets follow an elliptical orbit around the sun. According to Kepler's second law, the areal velocity of a planet remains constant, which means that the planet moves faster when it is closer to the sun (at perihelion) and slower when it is farther away (at aphelion).
